arguments.sql: SELECT c.has_chip, 1.0 * SUM(f.is_fraud) / COUNT(*) AS fraud_rate, COUNT(*) AS labelled_transactions, SUM(f.is_fraud) AS fraud_count FROM transactions t JOIN fraud_labels f ON f.transaction_id = CAST(t.id AS TEXT) JOIN cards c ON c.id = t.card_id GROUP BY c.has_chip ORDER BY c.has_chip
arguments.explanation: Shows the fraud rate on labelled transactions split by whether the card has a chip, with the transaction and fraud counts for each group.
assumptions: Same definition as the earlier brand query: labelled transactions only, joined to cards through card_id.
has_chip is taken from the card the transaction was made on, not from the transaction type.
